content:
Hello ! As the title mentions, I'm a new player. I've been playing for 13 days now, mainly because of the Saya no Uta collab, and I'm really enjoying the game so far! My account is currently level 51.

I've already read Cheri's New Player Handbook, which helped me a lot, but I'm now a little lost about what I should improve on my account and what I should pull for next.

I tried to keep this as short as possible, but I'm sorry for the huge wall of text 😭

I'll attach screenshots of all my characters and weapons below.

My initial goal was to build around Saya, and I'm currently thinking about Saya / Helot / Thais / Mouchette. However, since I'll eventually need to build 4 teams i also want to make sure I'm investing in the right characters for my account overall.

I'd really appreciate some advice on :

1) I'm planning to pull Mouchette when her banner becomes available. Should I aim for E0 + her signature weapon, or invest further? What about having Glotan too?
2) For the standard banner, should i still prioritize awakeners, or focus purely on blade of the titans?
3) I'm also hesitating between Saya E3 (mine is E1) and Thais E2, since Thais is apparently one of the best supports in the game should i upgrade her first with prototype horizon first ?
4) is it time for me to spend some menophin on Covenant or should i focus on spending everything on event ?
Resources:
I currently have 2 Prototype Horizon, 5 Protoparadise, 2 Books of Rotation and 1 Timeloop Copy left. Should I use these to upgrade my current characters, or save them for other characters?

Menophin:
I currently have 38 Special Potion Supply. Should I spend some of them on Covenant, or save them for events such as "Til the Snow Melts"? I've heard that some events are much more efficient for spending Menophin than the Saya event.

Current resources: 364 Pure Core / 266 Luminous Core + enough Silver for 194 more Luminous Core.

Thanks in advance ! Sorry for the huge wall of text again.
thread_title: 13-day player looking for advice on pulls & progression

content:
Hello there and welcome aboard ~

Lvl 50 in two weeks ... I feel I should be the one asking you for advice instead x'D

1. E1 is near mandatory with Mouchette. E2 lets her hit more often and E3 makes her strikes hit more after her exhalt.

Considering the guarentee is usuakky set at 30 pulls per SSR and 1 rate-up SSR per 3 SSR that makes 1 guarented Mouchette within 90 pulls.
That's 270 pulls for E2.

Maybe you *will* get lucky but if you olan to invest ik her I suggest you keep as many cores as you can until then : )

2. I'm honestly not too fond of chasing after that +12 BoT. But either way, your rosterstill feels a little strained so I'd recommand you fill your five teams before you move on to WoDs

3. Thaïs E2 means between 15 and 45 free aliemus each turn depending if you play with Saya and wether you turn them into scions.

Saya's E2 give an almost neglectable boost to embryo generation but E3 increases corrosion dealt and cards drawn by viscera blossom ( 0-cost shuffle ).

If you enjoy playing with her it certainly is worthwhile in the long run. If you're planning to go Mouchette it might be more interesting for you to forgo Saya's E3 for now.
And there's always the option to raise her later with proto

4. That's a question for veterans I feel. You can ask in https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1433513650299076780

I recommend keeping your selectors stashed until you find an answer for yourself. They are a precious ressource and thisnis, after all, a game. So light as well spend them according to your own preferences.
Just check if they expire.

About Menophin : you'll get ton of these so the easiest way is to clear all event stores first.

Saya and GHelot indeed provide endless stores but they are indeed rather ineffective cost-wise.
Unless you need a specific ressource like potions.
